primaryChecks.text: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

context.text: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”
Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.
